phaseName: Phase 2 — Backend: orchestrator, agents, persistence, API
goal: A bootable backend that accepts goals via REST, decomposes and assigns them to simulated agents, drives the full task lifecycle autonomously, persists lessons to SQLite, and broadcasts everything over WebSocket
summary: Phase 2 delivered a fully operational simulated-agent backend after one grading remediation round. Core: server/src/db.ts (node:sqlite factory: idempotent schema + FK pragma, typed CRUD goals/agents/tasks/lessons, injectable IDs, prepared statements, JSON activity, deterministic newest-first lessons), server/src/orchestrator.ts (pure: decomposeGoal -> pending goal + deterministic 4-task researcher/coder/reviewer template with blank-throw and 60-char topic truncation; least-loaded role-matched assignTasks + retryUnassigned; aggregateGoalStatus with failed precedence), server/src/agents.ts (createSimulation: mulberry32 seeded RNG, synchronous tick, 2-4 tick budgets, todo->in_progress->done/failed with role-flavored thought-chain activity, Lesson from/Pitfall from banking with topic-interpolated copy, fresh-object WsEvent emission, idempotent terminal ticks, unref'd start()), server/src/ws.ts + api.ts + index.ts (WS hub at /ws with dead-client cleanup; REST: POST /goals 400/201, GET /goals/:id 404, GET /agents, GET /lessons ?limit 1..200, GET /state; production boot with file db, 3-agent seed, env config, signal teardown; createApp(db, emit) with NO unused sim param). Grading remediation: pitfallNote params now interpolate topic (lint clean), unused TaskUpdatedEvent alias removed, dead createApp sim parameter removed across 3 call sites — verified by .kimchi/docs/verification.md: npm run lint exit 0 zero problems, typecheck exit 0 both workspaces, root npm test exit 0 with Tests 68 passed (68) identical to pre-fix baseline. Test coverage: 67 server tests (db 30, orchestrator 14, lifecycle 7, api 12 incl. WS client assertions, lessons/restart 2) + 1 web sanity; plus a recorded boot smoke of a real process running a full autonomous goal to done with 4 lessons banked.
stepSummaries:
1. Implement server/src/db.ts: node:sqlite schema (goals, agents, tasks, lessons) + typed CRUD functions, plus server/src/db.test.ts covering roundtrip writes and reads [verified]
  2. Implement server/src/orchestrator.ts: goal decomposition (goal text -> >=3 role-matched sub-task templates across Researcher/Coder/Reviewer), role-based assignment to registered agents, goal status aggregation; with orchestrator.test.ts asserting count, role matching, and assignment [verified]
  3. Implement server/src/agents.ts + tick loop: simulated agents autonomously transition assigned tasks todo -> in_progress -> done/failed with seeded outcomes and realistic activity messages (the PRD's thought-chain stand-in), generating a Lesson on every completion and every failure (failures shared as pitfalls to avoid); lifecycle.test.ts runs a full sample goal to completion deterministically [verified]
  4. Implement server/src/api.ts + ws.ts + index.ts: REST endpoints POST /goals (400 on empty text), GET /state, GET /goals/:id, GET /agents, GET /lessons (404 for unknown goal), WS hub broadcasting every state mutation, boot wiring of orchestrator loop; api.test.ts starts the server on an ephemeral port, exercises all endpoints, and asserts a WS client receives task.updated events after POST /goals [verified]
  5. Restart persistence: lessons.test.ts boots the store, completes a task so a lesson is written, closes and reopens the SQLite file/server, and asserts GET /lessons still returns the entry [verified]
